title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Job Summary: ​We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support our manufacturing plant operations. This role is essential for managing front-office activities, employee services, compliance tasks, and various reporting functions. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy multitasking, this position is for you.​
Responsibilities:
  • Serve as the primary front office contact for administrative tasks, including answering main line calls, assisting vendors and customers, greeting visitors, and managing incoming mail.
  • Manage hourly employee timekeeping for the processing of payroll, attendance tracking, and payroll check distribution.
  • Process daily retail sales and invoicing (routing).
  • Organize and scan documentation to support internal audits, compliance efforts, and accounting processes.
  • Assist in file management project (Iron Mountain).
  • Manage the plant badge access system, process badge requests, and conduct audits as needed.
  • Perform general administrative tasks as may be assigned.
Requirements:
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
    2+ years of administrative experience (manufacturing environment preferred).
    Previous experience with time keeping is nice to have.
    Proficiency in Microsoft Office (working knowledge of Excel).
    ERP systems (M3, Workbrain, Power BI) nice to have.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
    Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
  • Candidate will be going to loading dock to pick up and drop off paperwork. Candidate must wear rubber sole shoes.

description:

title: Senior Process Automation Engineer – Smart Manufacturing
description:
Job Locations:
  • Eddyville, Iowa
  • Hammond, Indiana
  • Blair, Nebraska
Job Purpose and Impact:
  • The Regional Smart Manufacturing Senior Project Engineer will transform the way we work. In this role, you will be asked to develop and drive projects amid the Smart Manufacturing portfolio.
  • The Smart Manufacturing engineer will drive these projects through detailed design, technology pilots and plant trials, project execution, startup and commissioning, value tracking and sustainment activities and project closeout.
  • This role is expected to provide technical leadership and expertise in the evaluation, development and implementation of new manufacturing processes, controls, instruments and equipment.
  • You will also focus on improving costs and value of existing products including, but not limited to raw material utilization, optimization of ingredients and manufacturing/production processes.
Key Accountabilities:
  • Lead engineering projects or segments of larger capital projects in the testing and evaluation of new technologies to reduce cost or improve the value of existing products or processes.
  • Utilize knowledge of products, ingredients and processes to assess alternatives and understand broad implications of possible changes and to leverage cross functional expertise and apply best practices to solution identification.
  • Evaluate new technology solutions and value optimization projects with considerations for experimental design and data analysis using a science-based approach.
  • Establish clear deliverables for projects and utilizes project charters, protocols and project reports to effectively plan, execute and document the work of the project in a timely manner using project management skills and tools.
  • Understand customer requirements and expectations on projects and identifies, maintains and defends intellectual property opportunities as they arise.
  • Independently handle complex issues with minimal supervision, while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of four years of related work experience.
  • Ability to travel up to 40% of the time.
  • Experience in scientific procedure, project management, experimental design, data analysis and interpretation and project documentation.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering with experience in plant operations, process engineering, project engineering, process controls and automation, manufacturing technology, production excellence or related technical field.
  • Strong project management skills and experience managing a portfolio of projects simultaneously.
  • Automation and technology development experience.
  • Experience with technologies that exist within our Starches, Sweeteners, Texturizers business group.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:
  • The Quality Assurance Manager is a key member of the manufacturing site leadership team that provides leadership at the site for development, implementation and administration of the Quality assurance and quality control functions to ensure safety integrity and conformance with respect to regulatory, corporate, site, and customer requirements. This position will work in collaboration with the plant and corporate leadership to formulate and execute a strategic quality plan for the business. This position also integrates quality priorities into the operational excellence process.
  • Responsible for managing CAPA program, including customer complaint, vendor complaint, holds and site audit nonconformance programs and root cause analysis thereof. Responsible for management of change control and portions of commercialization process. Provides leadership to develop and implement food safety, preventive controls and prerequisite programs (eg: HACCP/HARPC, Pest Control, Recall, Allergen, Sanitation, and environmental monitoring.)
  • As a member of the plant leadership team, requires comprehensive understanding of the concepts and principles within their own functional area, and also requires basic knowledge of these elements in their relevant functional areas in order to participate in the resolution of issues that have an impact beyond the area or impact multiple areas.
Key Responsibilities
  • Maintaining customer quality satisfaction through the implementation and use of programs to control raw materials, in-process materials, production process, environmental conditions and finished products.
  • Empowers and develops their team and cross functional teams. Performs evaluations and creates development and or training plans for team members and manages employee relations.
  • Ensures compliance with applicable laws and regulations such as FDA, EPA, OSHA and other state and federal agencies. Ensures compliance with contracted third party certifications such as GFSI, Kosher, Halal, RSPO or others as needed.
  • Conducts or coordinates Customer, Vendor and/or third party audits and regulatory inspections. Executes plans that drive operational excellence for the operation. Prepares and oversees customer site visits and audits.
  • Interacts with other Quality Managers, and corporate leadership and ensures timely issue escalation. Leads quality team in commercial product onboarding and trial reviews, specification creation, formula and label reviews, inspection plans for raw materials, in process materials and finished materials.
  • Manages departmental staffing, management commitment and review process, budget & expenses and capital projects.
Secondary Responsibilities:
  • Partnership with site leaders and cross functional partners for goal setting, decision-making alignment, and training and development needs
  • Supports Supply Chain, Learning and Development, and Commercialization functions as needed
People:
  • Responsible for development and performance of the site quality team and ensuring training programs are in place for cross functional teams.
  • Builds strong cross functional relationships and demonstrates ability to effectively influence and execute site strategy
  • Develops a culture that drives quality improvements and efficiently interfaces with operational excellence processes
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external customers.
  • Timely escalation and communication of food safety, quality, financial issues
  • Effectively cascade goals using tools such as SMART goals. Aligns with teams on standard work.
  • Motivates and builds team strength
  • Makes determinations and decisions on performance and pay for team members.
Systems:
  • Responsible for the effective application of site Product Safety, Product Quality and prerequisite systems. Ensures these systems effectively interface with change control and commercialization processes.
  • Strong ability to root cause issues and eliminate the cause or implement engineering or systems improvements to enact robust prevention. Applies use of basic root cause tools.
  • Responsible for execution of internal audit program and ensures systems are working to reduce risk, and that corrective actions are completed
  • Drives priorities that have largest positive impact on key performance indicators and metrics including but not limited to; Inspection/Compliance performance, First Pass Quality, Complaints, Disposals, Inventory Health, Customer Responsiveness, CAPA closure and effectiveness, systems performance, environmental & sanitation performance.
  • Ensures that response to customers, inspectors and auditors are professional, timely, and in scope.
  • Collaborates with R&D, Production, and commercial teams in the development and preparation for production of new Products, Processes, and Equipment to support new product/customer launches. Ensures the process quantifies the probability of success and clearly communicates the risks and proposed mitigations as an outcome of first-time makes.
  • Interfaces with operational excellence programs to maximize effectiveness
  • Provide support and aid in preparation for customer visits and external audits
Knowledge & Experience:
  • Operated in an FDA regulated environment, ideally food or dietary supplement
  • Assess and mitigate food safety, regulatory, and cost risks.
  • Apply sanitation principles effectively.
  • Application of Statistical Process Control (SPC) for process evaluation and improvements.
  • Effective project manager that knows how to prioritize and meet deadlines
  • 5+ years of functional leadership experience
REQUIREMENTS:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in relevant field
  • Project Management & Change Management Experience
  • 5+ years of experience in food, supplement, or related industry.
  • Familiarity with FDA
  • GFSI Scheme (ie SQF, BRC)
  • Certification focused on Quality and Food Safety for Supply Chain requirement: PCQI or HACCP
  • Ability to lift 50 lbs; required to stand, walk, sit, and reach.
SKILLS & CERTIFICATIONS:
  • 5 years+ Quality Assurance experience.
  • Solid FDA, HACCP, SQF, and industry best practices experience.
  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Creates and maintains a Quality culture.
  • Industry experience - Food/Bev Mfg, Pharma, Medical Device.

title: Lead Electrical Engineering – Ordnance & Ruggedized Systems
description:
Job Details:
  • Job Schedule: 4/10: Employees work 10-hour shifts, 4 days a week
  • This Electrical Engineering position is in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, requiring tasking flexibility to meet ever changing customer objectives. It will require the ability to work within a team structure as well as work independently with minimal supervision. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, are crucial.
Essential Functions:
  • Analog and digital design of ruggedized electronics for ordnance applications.
  • Circuit tolerance analyses using hand calculations and Spice tools
  • Requirements development, refinement, and compliance.
  • Generate test plans and test reports related to product performance (Brass board, Design Verification, Qualification, Firing Properties, etc.)
  • Lead and direct test activities in all phases of product development cycle.
  • Lead failure investigations using structured tools (8D, Fishbone, Cause & Effect, etc.).
  • Generate material for and lead design reviews for all phases of the product development cycle.
  • Act as primary technical interface to internal and external customers.
  • Provide inputs (material and labor estimates) for Requests for Proposals (RFPs)
  • Generate Engineering Orders (EOs) and Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs)
  • Mentor electrical engineering staff
  • Lead and multi-task across several projects simultaneously
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering or related field of study and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree in electrical engineering or related field and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
  • 5+ years of experience designing with basic analog building blocks including differential amplifiers, op amps, LDOs, filters, and data converters.
  • 5+ years of experience designing with basic digital building blocks including logic gates, flip flops, timers, and filters.
  • 4+ years of experience with power conversion concepts (AC/DC, DC/DC, and DC/AC, Linear and Switching Supplies)
  • 5+ years of experience in troubleshooting using standard lab equipment (oscilloscopes, function generators, meters, etc.)
  • 4+ years of experience with schematic capture and/or board layout utilities (Altium, PADS, etc.)
  • 4+ years of experience lead a large-scale technical project from start to completion with minimal guidance
  • 4+ years of experience in preparing and participating in design reviews (internal and external)
  • 4+ years of experience in creating Technical Documentation (Test Plans, Test Reports, Drawings, etc.)
Preferred Additional Skills:
  • 4+ years of experience with Temperature sensors, MEMs accelerometers, differential pressure sensors, and GYROs
  • 5+ years of experience with serial communication buses including UART, SPI, and I2C
  • 5+ years of experience with Root Cause analysis
  • 4+ years of experience with general design best practices (EMI suppression, ESD protection, and Short circuit protection)
  • 5+ years of experience with power supply and power conditioning design
  • 5+ Years designing Electronic Safety and Arming Devices (ESADs) and Ignition Safety Devices IAW MIL-STD-1316 and MIL-STD-1901A.
  • 5+ years of experience presenting ESAD/ESAF/ISD designs to the Safety Review Boards (AFSRB, FISTRP, NNMSB)
  • 3+ years of experience energetic materials interfacing/testing (EFDIs, LEEFIs, Lead Charges, Boosters).
  • 5+ years of design for extreme environments (Vibration, Shock, Temperature, Temperature & Humidity)
  • Team Player with excellent communication skills to work effectively across different engineering disciplines.

title: Chief Commercial Officer | Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Key Highlights:
  • Our client is considering the application for either a Chief Commercial Officer or a Senior Financial Analyst. Both roles would report to the CEO, the CFO and the Strategic Advisor. The two position descriptions are presented together to assist decision making; only one of the roles is intended to be filled.
  • The Chief Commercial Officer is positioned as a senior executive appointment, with primary accountability for commercial leadership, capital markets engagement and Board-level decision support. The Senior Financial Analyst is positioned as a hands-on commercial analyst role that delivers many of the same outputs at a more operational level under the direction of the CEO, CFO and Strategic Advisor.
  • Both roles support core financial outputs (such as group budgeting and statutory cash forecasting) through an interface with the CFO and finance team, and provide the commercial overlay, scenario analysis and Board-ready materials for the executive team.

Chief Commercial Officer

Position summary:

  • The Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) is a senior executive appointment reporting to the CEO, the CFO and the Strategic Advisor. The CCO is the principal commercial counsel to the executive team and the Board, with primary accountability for the commercial framing of group budgets, cash and capital models, external financial market engagement and the analysis that underpins strategic decision making across Client Minerals and its subsidiaries, including Kulu Minerals.
  • The CCO partners closely with the CFO and the broader finance team. Core financial activities such as group budgeting, statutory and operational cash forecasting, management reporting and accounting driven analytics are delivered through this interface with the CFO and finance team. The CCO provides the commercial overlay, scenario analysis and strategic framing of those outputs for the executive team and the Board, and works alongside the Strategic Advisor on transaction structuring, capital markets positioning and Board-level advisory matters.

Reporting and key relationships:

  • Reports to: CEO, CFO and Strategic Advisor
  • Direct reports: Senior Analyst (where appointed); external advisers as required
  • Key internal relationships: CEO, CFO and finance team, Strategic Advisor, Board of Directors, General Manager Exploration, Company Secretary, Subsidiary leadership (including Kulu Minerals)
  • Key external relationships: Sell-side and buy-side analysts, institutional and retail investors, brokers, corporate advisers, lenders, auditors, regulators, joint venture and offtake counterparties

Key responsibilities:

Strategy and Commercial Advisory:

  • Act as the principal commercial sounding board to the CEO and Strategic Advisor on strategic initiatives, including corporate restructuring, project prioritization, joint ventures, divestments and capital raisings.
  • Lead commercial evaluation of new opportunities, partnerships and transactions, ensuring decisions are tested against current and forecast cash, capital and shareholder-value impacts.
  • Contribute to the development and refresh of the group's strategic plan and provide independent commercial challenge to operational proposals.

Budgeting and financial planning:

  • Lead the group budgeting cycle in partnership with the CFO and finance team, ensuring the budget reflects commercial priorities and the strategic direction set by the CEO and Board.
  • Provide commercial framing, top-down challenge and scenario overlays to the bottom-up budget data assembled by the finance team.
  • Coordinate quarterly reforecasts with the CFO and finance team, and present material variances and their commercial implications to the executive team and the Board.
  • Establish, jointly with the CFO, the budget governance and tracking framework that links operational activity to commercial outcomes.

Cash and capital modelling:

  • Maintain the group commercial cash model and project-level financial models, drawing on actuals, forecasts and balance sheet inputs supplied by the CFO and finance team.
  • Stress tests the group's funding runway under a range of commodity price, exploration spend and equity market scenarios, in coordination with the finance team's underlying cash forecasts.
  • Recommend the timing, structure and quantum of equity, debt and hybrid capital initiatives, working with the CFO, the Strategic Advisor and corporate advisers on execution.

Capital markets and analyst engagement:

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact for sell-side and buy-side analysts in conjunction with the CEO and Strategic Advisor.
  • Prepare investor presentations, analyst briefings, fact sheets and supporting commercial materials, in coordination with the Company Secretary on continuous disclosure obligations.
  • Build and maintain consensus tracking, peer benchmarking and shareholder analytics to inform Board and executive decisions.
  • Support investor roadshows, conferences and one-on-one meetings, with attendance in Australia and offshore as required.

Decision support and reporting:

  • Develop and present commercial papers, options analyses and Board materials that articulate trade-offs clearly and defensibly.
  • Establish a small number of high-signal commercial KPIs and report against them to the executive team and the Board.
  • Ensure analytical work is reproducible, version-controlled and capable of withstanding due diligence scrutiny from external parties.

Governance and risk:

  • Work with the CFO and Company Secretary to ensure commercial activities are conducted within the group's risk appetite, delegations of authority and continuous disclosure framework.
  • Identify and escalate commercial, market and capital risks to the executive team and the Board on a timely basis.

Qualifications and experience:

  • Tertiary qualifications in commerce, finance, economics, engineering or a related discipline; a postgraduate qualification (CA, CFA, MBA or equivalent) is highly regarded.
  • Twelve or more years of post-qualification experience spanning two or more of: corporate development, investment banking, equities research, corporate strategy or senior commercial roles in resources.
  • Demonstrated experience in the resources sector (mineral exploration, development or production) is strongly preferred, including familiarity with PNG or comparable operating jurisdictions.
  • Direct experience advising boards and chief executives of ASX-listed (or comparable) entities, including in IPO, secondary raising or corporate restructuring contexts.
  • Strong existing relationships with Australian institutional investors, sell-side analysts and corporate advisers covering the resources sector.

Skills and attributes:

  • Exceptional financial modelling, scenario analysis and capital markets judgement.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical and operational detail into commercial narrative for non-specialist audiences.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, competing priorities and Board-level scrutiny.
  • High personal integrity, sound commercial instinct and a collaborative working style with the CEO, CFO and finance team, the Strategic Advisor, operational leadership and the Board.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and to PNG on a regular basis.

Location and arrangements

  • The role is based in Australia ( Brisbane or Sydney), with regular travel to other sites including Papua New Guinea.
  • Hybrid working arrangements are available.

Senior Financial Analyst

Position summary:

  • The Senior Analyst is a hands-on commercial role reporting to the CEO, the CFO and the Strategic Advisor. The Senior Analyst is responsible for building and maintaining the commercial analytics that support strategic decision making across Client Minerals and its subsidiaries, including Kulu Minerals: commercial budget views, cash and project models, capital markets materials and ad hoc commercial analysis for the executive team and the Board.
  • The Senior Analyst works closely with the CFO and the broader finance team. Core financial activities such as group budgeting, statutory and operational cash forecasting, management reporting and accounting-driven analytics are delivered through this interface with the CFO and finance team. The Senior Analyst builds commercial views, scenario analysis and Board-ready materials on top of those outputs for the CEO and Strategic Advisor, and supports their engagement with the Board and the market.

Reporting and key relationships

  • Reports to: CEO, CFO and Strategic Advisor
  • Key internal relationships: CEO, CFO and finance team, Strategic Advisor, General Manager Exploration, Company Secretary, Subsidiary leadership (including Kulu Minerals)
  • Key external relationships: Sell-side and buy-side analysts, retail and institutional investors, brokers, corporate advisers and auditors (in support of the CEO and Strategic Advisor)

Key responsibilities:

Budgeting and forecasting:

  • Coordinate the group budgeting cycle in partnership with the CFO and finance team, working with cost center owners across Client Minerals and Kulu Minerals.
  • Consolidate the bottom-up budget data prepared by the finance team into commercial views, variance, sensitivity and scenario outputs for the executive team.
  • Support the quarterly reforecast process run by the finance team, and prepare commentary explaining material movements and their commercial implications.

Cash and project modelling:

  • Maintain the group commercial cash model and project-level financial models, drawing on actuals, forecasts and accounting inputs supplied by the CFO and finance team, with assumptions and outputs clearly documented and version-controlled.
  • Run scenario and sensitivity analysis around commodity prices, exploration spend, capital raising timing and other key drivers.
  • Support funding planning, including the timing and sizing of potential equity, debt and hybrid initiatives, in coordination with the CFO and the Strategic Advisor.

Capital markets and analyst engagement:

  • Prepare investor presentations, analyst fact sheets, peer benchmarking and consensus tracking, working with the CEO, the Strategic Advisor and the Company Secretary.
  • Respond to information requests from sell-side and buy-side analysts under the direction of the CEO and Strategic Advisor and within continuous disclosure constraints.
  • Maintain a shareholder register analytics view and prepare market updates for the Board.

Strategic decision support:

  • Build commercial evaluations, option papers and Board-grade analytics for new opportunities, partnerships, restructuring steps and capital initiatives.
  • Translate operational and technical inputs into clear commercial outputs that support decisions by the executive team and the Board.
  • Support due diligence on transactions, including data room population, model review and Q&A coordination.

Reporting and governance:

  • Produce monthly and quarterly commercial reporting packs for the executive team and the Board, drawing on management accounts and finance team outputs.
  • Maintain a clear audit trail of models, assumptions and analytical outputs.
  • Ensure work is conducted within the group's risk appetite, delegations of authority and continuous disclosure framework.

Qualifications and experience:

  • Tertiary qualifications in commerce, finance, economics, engineering or a related discipline. Progress towards or completion of CA, CPA or CFA is highly regarded.
  • Five to eight years of relevant post-qualification experience, ideally including a combination of corporate finance or equities research and an in-house commercial or FP&A role.
  • Exposure to the resources sector (mineral exploration, development or production) is preferred; PNG or comparable jurisdiction experience is an advantage but not essential.
  • Demonstrable experience preparing Board, investor or analyst materials in a listed or pre-IPO environment.

Skills and attributes:

  • Advanced financial modelling skills, including scenario analysis, sensitivity testing and cash flow modelling.
  • Strong written communication, particularly the ability to produce concise, well-structured Board and investor papers.
  • High attention to detail and an instinct for sense-checking outputs before they leave the desk.
  • Comfortable working directly with senior executives and the Board, and operating with discretion on commercially sensitive information.
  • Collaborative working style, particularly with the CFO and finance team whose outputs the Senior Analyst will rely on.
  • Self-directed, well organised and able to manage multiple workstreams to tight deadlines.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and to PNG as required.

Location and arrangements:

  • The role is based in Australia (Brisbane or Sydney), with periodic travel to different sites including Papua New Guinea.
  • Hybrid working arrangements are available.

title: Windows System Administrator
description:

This position will also handle escalated incidents and perform root cause analysis of any problems that may arise out of Incident Report (IR) and/or proactive needs for business.

  • Vulnerability remediation.
  • Expert in Configuring and administering windows server 2008/2012/2016.
  • Good understanding of Exchange 2016 and Outlook related issues.
  • Maintain servers both physical and VM environment with maximum uptime.
  • Mastered in trouble shooting windows OS issues, handling escalated L3 issues in windows environment.
  • Firm understanding of Windows security including file system permissions, file sharing, event logging, performance monitoring and disk administration.
  • Good understanding of Active Directory and Network Infrastructure, Forest and Domain Infrastructure.
  • Responsible for third-level support for all server related issues. Implemented security policy and virus protection.

  • Performance optimization, regular health checks on servers and Systematic Troubleshooting of problems.
  • Involved in Customizing VM's Memory, hard disk, NIC and Analyzing log files, Resources utilizing monitoring.

  • Perform necessary analysis to provide all required evidences to support the project requirements.

  • Must be willing to handle varying shifts.
Minimum Qualifications

  • Four to five years of relevant experience
Required Skills:
  • Strong Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to effectively interact with upper management for presentation of new functionality and solving problems
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to work on-call in the emergency or priority issues.
  • Ability to take independent initiative when needed
  • Capital Markets Domain knowledge is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL), integration across Incident, Problem & Change (IPC) Management.
  • Knowledge about other products like BMC Control-M(CM), Cross File Transfer (CFT), Connect Direct and NetBackup is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of IT infrastructure and troubleshooting.
  • Technical and system expertise in relevant IT workstreams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced troubleshooting, including the ability to delve in more complex issues, which require a deeper understanding of systems and applications.
  • Specialized knowledge in specific areas allowing them to tackle intricate problems.
  • Collaboration with L1 Support to provide guidance and share insights for ongoing issue resolution.
  • Strong problem-resolving abilities, communication skills (written and verbal), time administration and management, and the team partnership and collaboration.
  • Escalation to L3 Support in timely manner when challenges require an even higher level of expertise and/or experience.
  • Ability to effectively interact with stakeholders in implementation of new functionality and solving problems.
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Capability to coordinate and execute projects assigned. Basic understanding of IT infrastructure and troubleshooting.

title: Microbiology Section Lab Supervisor
description:
Job Summary:
  • Section Supervisor is a Clinical Laboratory Scientist to work either location such as Modesto, California or Turlock, California, responsible for supervising one section of the lab, correctly performing technical procedures and Quality Control, operating and maintaining instrumentation and taking steps necessary to assure quality results and performing other duties as needed.
  • Every employee of the laboratory of our Medical Center is expected to promote the mission and the philosophy of the hospital by acting in a caring, courteous and confidential manner towards patient's, visitors, colleagues and staff by performing their duties and responsibilities according to the expected standards.
  • Every member of the Laboratory Staff is expected to perform their duties and to accept the responsibility of the accuracy of their work as dictated in their Professional Standards as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist or Health Care Workers.
  • Staff members will maintain confidentiality of all reports, maintain the integrity of identification of the patient samples and will perform designated tasks which will enable the laboratory to comply with all regulatory standards or Clinical and Anatomic Laboratories.   
Skills and Certifications:
  • ASCP Registry.
  • Clinical Lab Scientist.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Job Summary: Our client is a dynamic, rapidly expanding company offering exciting opportunities in language and cultural services, training and education, IT and cybersecurity, and intelligence (analysts, CI, HUMINT, SIGINT, and related specialties). The client's mission is to drive strategic growth by identifying, qualifying, and capturing federal contracting opportunities that expand their portfolio across U.S. government agencies.
Essential Job Function:
  • Lead business development and capture efforts across the full federal procurement lifecycle—from opportunity identification through contract award.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline aligned with company capabilities, develop and execute win strategies, and foster strong relationships with government stakeholders and industry partners.
  • Support proposal development by contributing to solutioning, pricing strategies, and competitive positioning.
  • Monitor market trends, competitors, and regulatory changes to inform growth strategy, while maintaining accurate pipeline tracking and reporting within CRM systems.
Required Skills:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Government, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of business development, capture, or sales experience in federal contracting
  • Demonstrated success winning federal contracts (prime and/or subcontract)
  • Strong knowledge of FAR/DFARS and federal acquisition processes
  • Experience with contract vehicles (GWACs, IDIQs, BPAs, GSA Schedules)
  • Established network within federal agencies and/or government contractors
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
Desired Skills:
  • Experience in IT, cybersecurity, Special Operations, linguistics, intelligence, engineering, logistics, or related fields
  • Active security clearance (Secret or Top Secret).
  • Familiarity with tools such as GovWin, SAM.gov, FPDS, and USA Spending.
  • Capture management and/or proposal development experience.
  • Master's degree or relevant certifications (e.g., APMP).

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Position Overview: The Senior Technical Project Manager oversees all aspects of key client projects in a technical product engineering environment. This role is responsible for setting deadlines, assigning responsibilities, and monitoring project progress within budget and scope. The ideal candidate will facilitate Hybrid Agile project management processes for both hardware and software development, serving as a Scrum Master for multiple technical product development teams.
Responsibilities:
  • Manage key client projects by setting deadlines, assigning responsibilities, and monitoring progress within designated budget and scope.
  • Facilitate Hybrid Agile project management processes, principles, and practices across a combined hardware and software product engineering environment.
  • Serve as a Scrum Master for two or more technical product development teams, leading daily and weekly stand-up meetings.
  • Plan upcoming backlogs, prioritize team tasks, and organize work cycles into sprints for incremental delivery.
  • Create, update, and track comprehensive weekly project schedules using Primavera P6, MS Project, or Smartsheets.
  • Utilize internal Kanban tools, such as Zenhub, to organize and track tasks with internal teams and external stakeholders.
  • Write Epics and user stories, breaking them down into granular tasks with accurate time and resource estimates for planning purposes.
  • Coordinate directly with internal departments and clients to ensure all deliverables meet applicable compliance, scope, and budget requirements.
  • Proactively identify team impediments and collaborate with stakeholders or leadership to resolve risks quickly.
  • Perform physical duties related to site visits, including lifting a minimum of 30 pounds, driving vehicles, wearing protective equipment like hard hats, and working safely within manufacturing or engineering environments.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a closely related technical field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in engineering and technical program or project management.
  • Minimum of 5 years of dedicated experience functioning as a Project Manager.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience functioning as a practicing Scrum Master.
  • Proven experience working in a combined hardware and software engineering environment.
  • Proficiency in generating detailed project schedules using Primavera P6, MS Project, or Smartsheets.
  • Hands-on experience working with Zenhub or similar Kanban project management tools.
  • Native or bilingual English language proficiency.
  • Must possess a current, valid driver's license.
  • Must be a local resident of the Boston, MA area and available to work on-site full-time.
Desired Qualifications:
  • Active Scrum Master Certification (e.g., CSM, PSM).
  • Professional experience working with ISO 9001 quality management standards.

title: S2 Proposal Operations Manager
description:
Position Overview: The S2 Proposal Operations Manager leads the development and submission of comprehensive business proposals in response to government solicitations. This role requires coordinating a multidisciplinary team to craft compelling narratives that showcase the organization's capabilities, value proposition, and competitive advantages. A proposal manager must ensure that each proposal is compliant with the RFP guidelines, meticulously organized, and delivered within strict deadlines. They are responsible for managing the proposal schedule, overseeing content creation, conducting reviews for quality assurance, and ensuring alignment with company policies and customer requirements. The proposal manager acts as a liaison between the proposal team, management, and ancillary functions, providing clear communication and updates throughout the proposal process.
Essential Responsibilities:
  • Supports Business Development with artifacts, deliverables, and advice during early pursuit period.
  • Works seamlessly with Business Development, Capture Manager, Program Manager, Program Engineer, and others in the development of pursuit artifacts proposal responses.
  • Assumes responsibility for development and delivery of proposal artifacts, including:
  • Ensures proposal efforts are properly staffed.
  • Develops and implements detailed proposal schedule.
  • Conducts status meetings to ensure coordinated proposal activities and issues identification and resolution.
  • Assigns Book Bosses to proposal volumes and checks progress.
  • Ensures win themes, discriminators, and ghosting requirements are allocated and met.
  • Ensures proposal activities are scheduled and tracked, providing status to management.
  • Ensures proposal volume writing, graphics, formats, and layouts are complete, compliant and compelling.
  • Manages thorough in-process reviews, ensuring feedback is integrated into the response.
  • Ensures compliance to all RFP requirements, including generation of compliance matrixes.
  • Coordinates proposal post-delivery activities (customer inquiry/EN/DR responses, etc).
  • Leads team to maintain Proposal Reference Library including parsed content, lessons learned inputs, and list of Opportunity SharePoint.
Basic Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree and minimum 9 years prior related experience. Graduate Degree with a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
  • Ability to obtain a security clearance.
  • Proposal management experience.
  • APMP or Shipley certification.
  • Writing, editing and desktop publishing experience.
  • Expert MS Office skills.
  • Defense and/or aerospace industry experience.

title: Mechanical Engineering Manager & Lead Engineer
description:
Job Details:This is a dual role manager and engineer position. It requires a leader that can staff, develop, and drive a team of both engineers and designers to accomplish program work. This individual will also apply mechanical engineering principles to design and maintain the company's FOS product lines during new product design, development, and sustain production across a multidisciplinary team. This individual must be able to work within established design guidelines to ensure products meet or exceed customer and industry specifications. In addition, this role supports production of existing products, working with manufacturing and quality to troubleshoot issues, document changes, and adhere to AS9100 and ISO9001 quality standards.
Job Schedule: 4/10
Essential Functions:
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of engineers and designers
  • Support hiring, workforce planning, and performance management
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and continuous improvement culture
  • Provide inputs (material and labor estimates, technical content) for Requests for Proposals (RFPs)
  • Define, maintain, and improve the department's development processes and best practices
  • Serve as lead mechanical engineer, responsible for design integrity and product performance and compliance
  • Drive mechanical design decisions across new product development and legacy product support
  • Develop and refine mechanical designs in accordance with internal standards and customer specifications
  • Apply GD&T, tolerance analysis, and sound engineering principles to ensure manufacturability and performance
  • Perform engineering calculations and collaborate with analysts to validate designs (FEA, thermal, shock/vibration)
  • Define and execute design verification strategies (shock, vibration, thermal, acceleration, etc.)
  • Prepare and present materials for internal and customer design reviews
  • Ensure compliance with applicable industry, customer, and regulatory standards
  • Support production by troubleshooting issues, implementing design updates, and improving processes
  • Partner with manufacturing and quality teams to resolve nonconformances and drive corrective actions
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree and minimum 9 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 7 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 13 years of prior related experience.
  • Professional experience using CAD software such as Solid Edge, SolidWorks, NX etc.
  • Professional experience with GD&T application and interpretation according to ASME Y14.5 and ASME Y14.100
  • Professional experience with dimensional stack-up/tolerance analysis.
Preferred Additional Skills:
  • Strong fundamentals in mechanics, vibration, fatigue, and thermal concepts.
  • Experience with DFMA and manufacturing processes.
  • Familiarity with AS9100 / ISO 9001 quality systems and working in a regulated environment.
  • Experience with FEA tools and test validation methods.
  • Advanced degree (MS) in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering.
  • An active DOD Secret Security Clearance.

title: Senior Credit Analysts
description:
Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off, Matching 401k.
About The Role:

  • As a Senior Credit Analyst, you will be responsible for monitoring and optimizing our credit portfolio. This role sits within the Data team and works directly with Engineering and Product. You will also be responsible for creating credit policies for new initiatives and products, creating risk management strategies, and conducting ongoing testing and experimentation. This role requires the use of data analytics to derive insights and develop credit strategies. Cross-functional collaboration is also needed. Working with the Analytics and Engineering teams to create underwriting models and risk management capabilities, with the Product teams to develop new products, with the Merchant Pricing team to evaluate merchants, and with the Finance team to facilitate discussions with debt and equity investors are parts of the role.
  • We are looking for someone with a strong data sense and clarity of thought. You should be a great communicator and have the ability to drive impact based on your analyses.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Data and Engineering on building risk analytics capabilities.
  • Use advanced data analytics and critical thinking to derive insights and optimize credit strategies.
  • Own risk initiatives within new product formation and new market exploration.
  • Monitor portfolio as well as macroeconomic trends impacting loan performance. Drive adjustments to our underwriting and marketing strategies to mitigate risk.

Must Have:

  • 3+ years of data analyst experience; consumer credit risk experience strongly preferred.
  • Advanced with SQL and Python.
  • Deep understanding of statistics & Data Science.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive impact through analysis.
  • Looking for more direct experience with consumer fintech, bank, or Client.

title: Strategic Account Manager (Service, Tourism, Consumer Goods)
description:
Position Overview: We are looking for a proactive and high-performing professional to oversee key client portfolios and accelerate business growth. In this role, you will be responsible for the entire client lifecycle—from initial engagement to long-term retention—ensuring our solutions align perfectly with customer objectives. The ideal candidate is a master of relationship building who uses data to drive strategy and negotiation.
Core Responsibilities:
  • Revenue Generation: Own the end-to-end sales process, consistently hitting or surpassing established growth targets and KPIs.
  • Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, fostering high levels of trust and long-term partnership.
  • Needs Assessment: Conduct deep-dive evaluations of client challenges to propose tailored, high-impact solutions.
  • Pipeline Administration: Maintain rigorous data integrity within our CRM systems to track interactions and forecast accuracy.
  • Performance Analytics: Review sales data and market trends to pivot strategies and optimize territory performance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams to ensure seamless delivery of services and client satisfaction.
Required Qualifications:
  • Education: University degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related commercial field.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of proven success in high-level sales, business development, or account management.
  • Communication: Elite negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Technical Savvy: Proficiency in modern CRM platforms and data visualization tools.
  • Strategic Thinking: Demonstrated ability to manage complex, competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Desired Attributes:
  • Previous experience operating within the Service, Tourism, or Consumer Goods sectors.
  • Advanced proficiency in sales acceleration software and digital productivity suites.
  • A "solution-first " mindset with a track record of resolving complex client issues.

title: HR Analyst - HRIS (SAP SuccessFactors Implementation Consultant)
description:
Job Scope:
  • Support HR with analysis on programs, policies, processes, and systems.
  • Provide recommendations to improve HR management activities.
  • Deliver timely and effective support for HR issues.
  • Ensure HR programs align with organizational strategies and priorities.
  • Plan, schedule, and implement HR activities to support operations.
Key Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Conduct HR analyses and provide insights on policies, processes, and systems.
  • Identify gaps, interpret data, and benchmark against best practices.
  • Maintain and update HR policies, processes, and systems.
  • Handle queries from stakeholders regarding HR data, reports, and systems.
  • Implement and ensure stability of SuccessFactors modules.
  • Develop, implement, and evaluate HR policies and procedures.
  • Perform impact analysis on organizational changes and recommend improvements.
  • Maintain and update OM systems, organizational structures, positions, and workflows in SAP-ERP/SuccessFactors.
  • Monitor and ensure quality control of HR systems, processes, and records.
  • Support organizational effectiveness initiatives and change management.
  • Enhance HR processes by identifying bottlenecks, risks, and redundancies.
  • Manage system upgrades and collaborate with HRIS team for improvements.
  • Analyze organizational and industrial data to support decision-making.
  • Review and update organizational charts to ensure accuracy.
  • Support competency mapping with the Training & Development team.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Supervisor.
Minimum Requirements:
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Applications, or equivalent.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Professional Certification in SAP SuccessFactors (Employee Central Payroll, Employee Central, Onboarding, RCM, PMGM, or equivalent).
  • Skills: Strong knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors implementation and system stability.

title: Certified Compensation and Benefits Specialist
description:
Job Scope:
  • To serve as an analyst responsible for the management of employee compensation and benefits, including the design, development and implementation of the compensation and benefit policies and programs to support the Company's strategy and objectives, both short and long terms.
  • Work under the general directions of the Superintendent Rewards & HR Policies develop and maintain competitive compensation and benefit programs for the entire workforce of the Company. Ensure that the reward policies meet the needs of the human resources functions and support the needs of employees across the Company.
  • External Contacts: External HR Consulting Companies, Saudi Government Representative, Oil Company Counterparts, HR Compensation and Benefit Programs Specialists and Professionals.
Key Duties, Responsibility & Accountabilities:
  • Conduct studies, benchmarks and surveys to determine the feasibility and competitiveness of the Company's compensation and benefit programs.
  • Ensure that the Company's compensation and benefit programs meet the employees' needs and comply with legal requirements in Saudi Arabia.
  • Design and maintain Company's salary structure(s), over base components, merit and promotional increases and other related bonuses.
  • Ensure that compensation and benefits policies and processes are integrated into other HR policies, specifically performance management, talent management, career development and recruitment.
  • Support the implementation of various organizational HR strategies and programs to maximize their effectiveness, ensuring that compensation policies and programs are well understood and fully adopted.
  • Plan, conduct and participate in third-party's compensation surveys and benefit studies, analyze results to determine market competitiveness and provide recommendations on compensation and benefits issues.
  • Make/propose annual bonus recommendations and salary review recommendations.
  • Maintain comprehensive salary data to make and support compensation related decisions in coordination with all other HR functions.
  • Coordinate with Training and Career Development Division to ensure that performance appraisals for all Company's employees are submitted promptly to process pay and bonus changes.
  • Work with the Organization and Job Evaluation Analyst to assist in conducting job evaluations and ensure that pay rates are equitable and justifiable for all jobs across the Company.
  • Design and maintain Company's retention programs, including home ownership program, medical coverage for the employees, saving/thrift plan.
  • Liaise with the external consultants and third-parties appointed by the Company to carryout compensation and benefits related projects.
  • Act as a coach to other HR Department personnel with regards to compensation and benefits policies.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned by the HR Policies & Planning Superintendent.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Human Resource, Accounting, Business Administration or equivalent.
  • Six years of experience in Organizational Compensation and Benefits, of which at least Two years in a similar position.
  • Strong knowledge of the development and management reward strategies and data analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of best compensation and benefits practices locally and internationally.
  • General understanding of commercial markets and local labor market.
  • Strong analytical and quantitative abilities.
  • Good knowledge of the Refinery professions.
  • Ability to function independently and effectively in a self-directed environment.
  • Ability to plan, organize, and prioritize work effectively.
  • Conversant with SAP and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to perform work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
  • Strong command of oral and written English.

title: Senior Deal Manager (Senior Mergers & Acquisitions Manager)
description:
Job Summary:
  • Mergers & Acquisitions responsibility is to support long term vision and strategy, including acquisitions, partnerships, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic alliances.
  • The person in this role is engaged from the outset of a potential transaction and work closely with Corporate Finance, the Business, Legal, and other functions throughout the process.
  • This person will focus on structuring the transaction, leading due diligence, developing financial models, building the business case, managing the internal & external stakeholders, building a project team, governing the project, and building & presenting the business case to senior executives & board of directors.
Job Purpose & Responsibilities:
  • Day to day management of all aspects of Mergers & Acquisitions buy-side and sell-side transactions including preparation of marketing materials, financial analyses, investment/ information proposals; drive deal progression and achievement of milestones and be accountable and act in pursuit of the right outcome.
  • Lead all aspects of DD process including serving as the primary liaison for us and the counter party and leading internal and external teams carrying out all aspects of DD.
  • Create investment proposals along with supporting analysis and findings; drive deal progression and achievement of milestones including substantial role in negotiations of transaction terms and deal agreements.
  • Develop, analyze, challenge, and communicate options for the structure of the deal taking into account both internal and counterparty consideration to ensure that the envisaged economics and financial robustness of the deal are achieved (where required with input from internal and external advisors).
  • Negotiate engagements with external advisors (e.g., investment banks) including the specific deliverables in relation to the deal/ the appropriate fee structure for engagement and manage the contract to ensure "value for money " during the engagement.
  • Lead negotiations (including deal tactics, auctions vs. negotiated deal, agreement/ contract negotiation, etc.) with external parties including government bodies and assess & communicate during the negotiations the overall attractiveness of the deal vs. the mandate including making trade-offs.
  • Manage the preparation of offers, including LoI, with legal, tax, and other functional teams as well as external advisors to manage development and review of definitive agreements, deal structure; develop deal documentations for investment committees and board.
  • Design, Implement and maintain an appropriate governance structure to the phase of the project (deal) including managing the project budget and coordinating the internal authorization process.
  • Model the financial of commercial decisions to drive appropriate and balanced analysis and recommendations to support commercial decision making (including identifying the key associated risks with the deal/synergies arising out of the deal and incorporating it into the valuation); identifies alternatives to the proposed deals or business opportunities in order to make sure that all options are considered; conducts advanced risk and business analysis on complex scenarios in order to make reliable and fact-based decisions and recommendations.
  • Develop valuation analyses based on commonly used approaches including income, cost and market approaches and support/lead in negotiating valuation discussions.
  • Build scalable processes and capture best practices in the Mergers & Acquisitions space; monitor and develop junior staff.
Minimum Education/Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Business/Finance.
  • Advance studies in Finance or economics preferred.
  • 15+years' experience working in Petrochemical Manufacturing or Oil and Gas industries (preferably in business development).
  • Experience in overseeing & management of investment/deals (preferable).
Competencies and Skills:
  • Creativity and ability to think of Client approach.
  • Business Acumen.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with executives and build relationships at every level of the organization.
  • Skillful at building trust with and influencing senior level stakeholders.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, people/cultural diversity management and leadership skills.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
  • Strategic Focus.
  • Excellent team player and business relationships.
  • Proven ability to hit the ground running and work autonomously.

title: Fire Chief
description:
Job Scope:
  • Lead the firefighting and emergency response team.
  • Manage daily shift operations, scheduling, and duties.
  • Respond to operational issues and emergencies.
  • Ensure compliance with fire safety laws and regulations.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and command firefighting and emergency operations.
  • Conduct risk assessments to identify hazards and develop safety plans.
  • Inspect buildings for fire hazards, wiring issues, or blocked fire exits.
  • Follow up on fire code violations and ensure corrective actions.
  • Ensure firefighting equipment (trucks, vehicles, rescue gear, portable tools) is in good condition.
  • Inspect facilities with hazardous materials for compliance and issue permits.
  • Respond to all types of emergencies, including fire, toxic leaks, gas leaks, and rescues.
  • Conduct regular training sessions on fire prevention, safety, and firefighting techniques.
  • Train and guide Emergency Response Team (ERT) members and volunteers.
  • Provide mentorship and development opportunities within the department.
  • Conduct annual fire extinguisher training for employees.
  • Stay updated with new technologies and best practices in firefighting.
  • Review new building and remodeling plans for fire safety compliance.
  • Investigate incidents for negligence or code violations by staff.
  • Develop and manage fire prevention programs (false alarms, inspections, hazardous materials).
  • Communicate with teams and inspectors via phone or radio.
  • Investigate fire causes by collecting and analyzing evidence.
  • Coordinate emergency drills with internal and external agencies.
  • Provide support to outside agencies during emergencies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Minimum Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Fire Protection, or equivalent.
  • 9–12 years of relevant experience.
  • Fire Protection Certification (preferred).
